title: Process exporter metrics

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Specify which process level of metrics are collected from the host operating system.

fields.name: path.procfs
fields.description: The mount point used to collect process information and metrics.

fields.name: process_exclude_pattern
fields.description: Regular expression to determine which names of processes are excluded in the metrics produced by this plugin.

fields.name: process_include_pattern
fields.description: Regular expression to determine which names of processes are included in the metrics produced by this plugin.

fields.name: scrape_interval
fields.description: The rate, in seconds, at which metrics are collected.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.
